original_method: Continuity-corrected normal upper-tail approximation to summed Hypergeometric(40,k,5) number-hit counts.
amended_method: discrete upper-tail convolution of iid Hypergeometric(40,k,5) number-hit counts; deterministic float64 under independent uniform 5-of-40 draws

unchanged.candidate_selection: Discovery top-100, Validation freeze; Blind OOS never used for selection
unchanged.paired_inference: 20,000 circular moving-block bootstrap/sign-flip replicates, block length 7, seeds 920027/920028; Holm family size 4

limitations: The null assumes independent uniform 5-of-40 draws across target dates.
Float64 convolution is deterministic but not exact arithmetic; extreme tails below float64 range use a positive subnormal floor.
This amendment changes catalog-level p-value calibration only; it does not claim predictive skill.
